title: Built my first game for Vibe Jam, browser-based Vampire Survivors-style co-op/solo/local multiplayer (forgot the link last time haha)
author: BlittyB
selftext:
Would be awesome if you could help out and try it out even if it’s just once. Thanks!  

\- Vampire Survivors-style survival game     
\- Online co-op (room codes)    
\- Built entirely with AI tools for Vibe Jam    
\- Multiple classes + special weapons    
\- 6 Universal weapons    
\- Boss fights with projectile patterns   
\- Runs take \~10 minutes  

This was made in just a month with no prior experience.

comments.author: Rsloth
comments.body:
Not bad!   
  
Felt it was too easy but that could all be balanced.

The gems / coins could be more visible / enjoyable to pickup. It's kinda not that noticable.

replies.author: BlittyB
replies.body: Appreciate you trying it out! I played with 2 other friends and it was way too hard so I made the amount of XP you gain higher. It felt better but I guess I need to find that middle ground of too difficult and too easy.
